body: This does not seem to be related to your fix. Why are you adding a new CommandBinding to the layer? The Backstage itself already has such a CommanBinding.
Please move this method to the UIHelper class.
The backstages CommandBindings do not work when the window content is an arbitrary .NET Object. Thus I removed the commandbindings from the backstage and added it to the AdornerLayer.
The TabControl mirrors CanMinimize so we should use that one here instead of looking at the ribbon.
I think the changes to this file should be reverted as they are not needed.
